subject: CANCEL statement
notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB154): CANCEL never probes (probe:false), so a non-COBOL module is unreachable from CANCEL by construction and the implementor-defined effect is a decided 'no effect' rather than an incidental one. A.1 item 19 is discharged in docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 7 (result of canceling a non-COBOL program: no effect; CANCEL performs no sibling-module probe). The CALL-CONVENTION directive (§7.3.9) remains unimplemented but no longer bears on CANCEL's disposition (the prior row note's '7.3.4 GR2' locus for it was an inherited miscitation - §7.3.4 contains no CANCEL text).
